description: Sector benchmarks and sector statistics for a French NAF activity code (any level: 68, 68.2, 68.20, 68.20B): number of active companies, median company age (+quartiles), workforce-bracket distribution, and, when at least 5 companies file public accounts, median revenue, EBITDA margin, pre-tax result and debt ratio. Peer comparison: place a company against its peers. Aggregates only, no personal data. Paid via x402 ($0.05 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

code_naf.description: NAF rev. 2 activity code, any level (68, 68.2, 68.20, 68.20B): only the NAF rev. 2 form is retained (sub-class 62.01Z, and its levels: division 62, group 62.0, class 62.01); a code of an older nomenclature (NAF rev. 1: 55.3A, activity not recoded since rev. 2 came into force) is not, nor is INSEE's provisional value 00.00Z (no division 00 in NAF rev. 2); any other code is refused (400, not charged)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_sector_benchmarks

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French sector benchmarks (NAF)
